note: Marina campground on a Lake Sakakawea bay 2 miles west of New Town, beside 4 Bears Casino and the golf course, run by the non-profit New Town Marine Club on Corps of Engineers land. Gravel loops on open ground above the bay; boat ramp, docks and fish-cleaning station. One camper, one boat and one tow vehicle per site; no ATVs or UTVs. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: electric RV sites $25 (30/50 A at each site), electric tent $15, showers, dump, bait shop, phone reservations from May 1, open May 1-Oct 31. Fees/booking/season/hookups/facilities written; derived water hookup cleared. Ownership local -> private (non-profit Marine Club) suggested. Lakefront -> lakeview lead (no nightly site identified within 50 m).
flags: OWNERSHIP: local -> private. The operator's own pages: 'proudly operated by the New Town Marine Club, a nonprofit organization led by a dedicated volunteer board' on 'federally managed lands'; HHS licence owner 'NEW TOWN MARINE CLUB'. The City of New Town's site does not mention the marina; the stored note's 'operated in association with the City of New Town' is not supported (rule: a non-profit corporation running a park is private).

PRIVATE GATES (if reclassed private): rate $25 posted by the operator (2026 page) - under $50; presence: working website with phone (701) 627-3900; Google 4.5 from 33 reviews. Long-stay: a nightly rate is posted and booked by phone; 'Campers staying 7 days or longer are responsible for maintaining their campsite area' shows week-plus stays but no seasonal or monthly rate is advertised. HHS licence 92 lots. Passes.

WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview (lead). No site numbers or site map are published, so no nightly site can be placed within ~50 m of the water. The units nearest the bay (~47.9842,-102.5291, along the lane to the docks) are ~55-60 m from the waterline across a bare sloping shore and look like long-term units with sheds and private-looking docks; the main RV loops (~47.9830,-102.5314) sit 90-250 m from the coves on open ground with the bay in view.
PIN: stored 47.98200,-102.53050 is the southeast camper row; loops centre ~47.9830,-102.5314 (~130 m): ok.
